177.news_title: Introducing the New 21.3 Inch Arcooda 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitor with Integrated Speakers
177.long_description:
Arcooda is proud to introduce the new 21.3 inch 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitor with Integrated Speakers, a complete audio-visual display solution for arcade machines, retro gaming, industrial control systems, commercial displays, digital art installations and desktop applications.

Built around a traditional 4:3 screen format, this professional LCD monitor is ideal for users who need a modern replacement for older CRT style displays. The 21.3 inch IPS panel delivers a clear, detailed image with 16.7 million colours, 500 nit brightness, an 1800:1 contrast ratio and a fast 1.7ms display lag.

The monitor supports more than 160 pre programmed display modes, including native 15kHz, 24kHz and 31kHz signals. It can display classic low resolution video formats, including 240p and VGA, through to a maximum resolution of 1600 x 1200. This makes it suitable for older RGB and arcade game boards, retro gaming systems, desktop PCs and commercial display installations.

A key feature of this new Arcooda 4:3 LCD monitor is its integrated speaker system. With built in speakers included directly in the monitor, users can create a cleaner and more compact installation without needing separate external speakers for many applications. This is especially useful for arcade cabinet upgrades, digital displays, compact commercial setups and desktop installations where space is limited.

The monitor includes a wide range of connectivity options, including VGA, HDMI, DVI and DisplayPort inputs. This allows it to connect with legacy equipment as well as modern computers, media players and display hardware.

For retro gaming and arcade applications, Arcooda’s firmware support helps the monitor work with a broad range of compatible game boards and low-resolution video signals. The built in Auto Picture function can also be used to centre the image quickly, helping achieve a clean and properly aligned display.

Installation is flexible with VESA mounting support and supplied mounting brackets. The monitor is designed to suit a range of cabinet, wall mount, desktop and custom enclosure applications, giving installers more freedom when replacing an older CRT monitor or building a new display system.

The 21.3 inch Arcooda 4:3 Ratio LCD Monitor with Integrated Speakers brings together traditional screen proportions, modern LCD performance, broad signal compatibility and integrated audio in one practical display solution.

Whether it is being used for a retro arcade cabinet, an industrial control display, a commercial screen, digital artwork or a desktop PC setup, this Arcooda LCD monitor offers a reliable 4:3 display with the added convenience of built in speakers.
